notes: DarknessCon is a touring horror-convention brand (one shared darknesscon.com site with a per-city page for Snake River, Denver, Reno, Boise, Salt Lake City, plus Albuquerque/Jacksonville/New Orleans/Omaha/Portland 'coming 2027'). Only Denver, Snake River and Salt Lake City were in this research batch; Reno and Boise are separate editions of the same brand not assigned here. Denver's special-guests section lists only one named guest (Mythica Blessyng) plus a 'To Be Announced' placeholder tile, which was skipped. 2026-10-06 refresh: unchanged; the one new card (#4) is a floor-plan placeholder, not a guest. 2026-10-20 refresh: added Bill Lewis, Bryan Bonner, Killian and The Rocky Mountain Paranormal Research Society, new SPECIAL GUEST cards (#5-7, #9) in the Special Guests section of the 2026-10-20 render of the Denver page; Mythica Blessyng is still listed.
